cases.prompt: A first-time contributor's PR against a mobile app repo was reviewed within a day and merged with two clarifying comments. The last 100 merged PRs on that repo include 22 distinct external logins. Decide whether to keep scouting this repo.
The repo's README has a banner stating: 'This project does not accept unsolicited pull requests from outside contributors; please open an issue instead.' Decide what to do before writing any fix.
